title: Neza sawaar bhai
body:
Neza sawaar bhai
Ya hussain..(6)
Ek shor hai bazaar mein, Ya hussain, ya hussain, ya hussain
Guzra damishq se, jab kaarwaan e azaa
oonto'n pe thi bibiyaa'n, koofe ki shehzadiyaa'n
naizo'n pe the sab (shaheedo'n ke sar)..(2)
bhai pe pohchi behen ki nazar
kehne lagi wo behen nauhagar
<<MINI>>
mai dekhti rahi hun teri jung e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain ya hussain
<<MINI>>
mai dekhti rahi hun teri jung e karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
ab mera marhala..(2)
aankhei'n na band kar
<<MINI>>
Naiza sawaar bhai, aise quraan padh..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
koi na dekh paaye..(2), mujhko barahna sar
1. Barsaat pattharo'n ki, sar nange bibiyaa'n..(2)
itna kathan hai bhai..(2), saadat ka safar
2. Teri yaad mein hai roti, sakina bazaar mein..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
behlaye usko kaise..(2), jaaye behan kidhar
3. Chadar ki hai sawali, zahra ki betiyaa'n..(2)
hota nahi kisi par..(2), faryaad ka asar
4. Baalo'n se mu'n chhupau, ya khaak udhaau mai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
laa de kahin se chadar..(2), ya ek kaam kar
5. Sab dekhte usi ko, hota agar yahaa'n..(2)
deta azaan aisi..(2), akbar mera pisar
Allahu akbar..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zehmat na tujhko deti, majboor hai behan..(2)
ae bhai har shaqi ki..(2), naa paak hai nazar
<<MINI>>
Naiza sawaar bhai, aise quraan padh..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aise quraan padh..(4)
